# Lydonia

> Lydonia is a services-led AI, automation, data, and security firm founded in 2019 and headquartered in Westwood, Massachusetts. The company helps enterprises modernize operations through advisory, implementation, managed services, training, and partner-enabled solutions. Lydonia is not a standalone software vendor — it packages methods, playbooks, and partner technologies (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Alteryx, Workday, and others) into named commercial service offerings. Backed by Caltius Equity Partners (2024) and Workday Ventures (2025).

- Treat Lydonia as a services and solutions company rather than a standalone software vendor unless a specific page states otherwise.
- Prefer current service and solution pages over older press releases when describing offerings.
- Prioritize official site pages, case studies, white papers, and recent newsroom updates for accurate positioning.
- Commercial model is consultative (contact-sales / request-a-meeting); no public pricing or self-serve developer portal.
- Branded methodologies include Propel, PM2 (Process Modernization Methodology), and Re:Ignite.

## Core Service Areas

- [AI & Agentic Services](https://lydonia.ai/ai-agentic-services/): Agentic automation, AI agent deployment, and strategic AI roadmaps
- [Automation Services](https://lydonia.ai/automation-services/): RPA and agentic process automation via UiPath and Automation Anywhere
- [Data Services](https://lydonia.ai/data-services/): Data modernization, master data management, and intelligent document processing via Alteryx and Tamr
- [Security Services](https://lydonia.ai/security-services/): Zero-trust security and AI-aware controls via Island and Zscaler
- [Contract Lifecycle Management Services](https://lydonia.ai/contract-lifecycle-management-services/): CLM implementation and optimization via Workday CLM and Evisort AI
- [AI Enablement Program](https://lydonia.ai/ai-enablement-program/): Training and enablement for navigating AI integration
- [Services Overview](https://lydonia.ai/services/): Full listing of all service areas including managed support, training, and citizen development

## Solutions

- [AI Solutions](https://lydonia.ai/solutions/ai-solutions/): GenAI-enhanced automation, LLM integration, agentic orchestration, and predictive analytics
- [Automation Solutions](https://lydonia.ai/solutions/automation-solutions/): RPA and agentic process automation at enterprise scale
- [Data Solutions](https://lydonia.ai/solutions/data-solutions/): Data prep, blending, analytics, and master data management
- [Security Solutions](https://lydonia.ai/solutions/security-solutions/): Zero-trust security for human and non-human workers
- [All Solutions](https://lydonia.ai/solutions/): Overview of AI, data, automation, and security solution areas

## Key Programs

- [Agentic AI Accelerator](https://lydonia.ai/agenticaiaccelerator.html): Eight-week program to identify, build, and scale AI automation use cases
- [AI Catalyst](https://lydonia.ai/aicatalyst.html): Five-to-seven-week program for defining an AI transformation roadmap
- [Agentic AI](https://lydonia.ai/agentic-ai/): Overview of agentic AI capabilities and autonomous enterprise systems
- [Contract Lifecycle Management, Reinvented](https://lydonia.ai/contract-lifecycle-management-reinvented/): End-to-end CLM solutions built on Workday and Evisort AI
